FIX-UP MUTANT 11: unfiledFigureLabel prints the src when there is no alt (the renderers' old expression)
file: server/export/authoring-images.ts
--- mutation (diff vs the fix) ---
--- <scratch>/fixes2/figure-writers/mutant-tmp-authoring-images.ts	2026-09-28 19:27:56.006618332 +0000
+++ ./server/export/authoring-images.ts	2026-09-28 19:27:56.006831046 +0000
@@ -219,5 +219,5 @@
 export function unfiledFigureLabel(fig: { src?: string; alt?: string }): string {
   if (fig.alt) return fig.alt;
   if (!fig.src) return 'unresolved image reference';
-  return isGovernedImageRef(fig.src) ? fig.src : refusedKind(fig.src);
+  return fig.src;
 }
